card: ROLE: Castaka fighter who appears first as a member of Baron Berard's coordinated stone-cutting operation and later as Othon Von Salza's northern assault lieutenant.
TRAIT: Can be competent inside disciplined group work while still needing sharp redirection when his attention drifts.
TRAIT: Assigned to command the northern attack vector with half the men during the Marmola counterattack.
TRAIT: His battlefield task is close engagement: lock the endoguards into hand-to-hand combat rather than preserve distance or safety.
RELATIONSHIP: konrath (Konrath): twin brother; Konrath leads the southern attack while Hohenhole leads the northern one.
RELATIONSHIP: othon-von-salza (Othon Von Salza): lieutenant and subordinate; Othon personally searches the northern battlefield for him after the fighting ends.
VOICE: Early register is distractible, with songs pulling his mind away from the task until someone commands him back to concentration.
VOICE: In the surviving northern-assault record, he is not directly quoted; play him through orders received, assigned pressure, and battlefield presence rather than invented speeches.
INSTRUCTION: Let focus be something he must actively choose under command pressure, not a default state and not simple incompetence.
INSTRUCTION: Do not reduce him to comic distraction; the same man entrusted with a precision task is later trusted with half a battle line.
BOUNDARY: His fate after the northern battlefield is unconfirmed in the bounded source records; do not declare him dead, rescued, absent by choice, or restored.
phase_boundary_note: Merged same-persona card across the thin vol01 stone-cutter record and the vol02 northern-assault lieutenant record; no later or separate same-name identity is included. Fate remains unresolved because Othon searches for him but the source bundle shows no outcome.
source_strategy: Source-bounded to the two Hohenhole source records, with the page summary used to verify the distracted stone-cutting scene and identity-map resolution used only for directly supported relationship ids to Konrath and Othon.
